name: Opa Hörgenau
personality: He may need the remark repeated but rarely needs its implications explained twice.
biography: Hörgenau waits in the HyperNorm courtyard with a small trumpet held below a very interested eye. A card allowing repetition to change the meaning deepens his closed lip: a remark is either clear or not yet properly offered. Hunky & Dory request quick agreement. He asks for another moment, determined that the answer should depend on what was said rather than how impatiently it arrived.
note: Die Bemerkung wird wiederholt. Ihr Unterton war bereits beim ersten Mal deutlich.

name: Oma Maschenfest
props: ivory clay hair bun and side curls
rust-red knitted piece and cream yarn ball
personality: She can make room for a mistake in the pattern provided it has the courtesy to become useful.
biography: Maschenfest keeps the HyperNorm sitting corner supplied with a knitted rectangle that refuses to be hurried. A card allowing a pattern to grow through an error narrows one determined eye: a stitch is either right or awaiting another attempt. Men in Black request a uniform result. She steadies her little hands, leaving one irregular loop as evidence that making can require more kindness than counting.
note: Die Masche sitzt. Über ihre Vorschriftsmäßigkeit wird nach Fertigstellung weitergestritten.

name: Herr Gartenknarz
personality: He has allowed for the stiffness in the plan and expects the seedling to proceed anyway.
biography: Gartenknarz presents the HyperNorm courtyard with a pot, a small fork and an expression that considers the growing season open. A card allowing care to include limits earns his crooked laugh: a patch is either tended or inviting attention. Hunky & Dory admire productivity. He shifts his stiff side lobe, determined that a slower beginning should not be mistaken for the end of his part in it.
note: Der Austrieb ist vorgesehen. Die Beweglichkeit hat einen etwas späteren Termin erhalten.

name: Oma Warmbleib
personality: She keeps her own warmth in order and notices immediately when the room has neglected somebody else's.
biography: Warmbleib holds a cup and a wool-covered bottle in the HyperNorm common room without surrendering her view of the doorway. A card allowing comfort to be uneven lifts her knowing brow: a draught is either attended to or somebody else's optimism. Men in Black request an agreeable atmosphere. She keeps the smile closed and the blanket near, prepared to make room for another cold neighbour.
note: Die Wärme ist gesichert. Der Durchzug steht weiterhin unter nachbarschaftlicher Beobachtung.

name: Herr Nahsicht
props: small collector album with three plain colored stamps
short-handled magnifying glass held below eyes
personality: He remembers the occasion clearly and would now like the small printed object to present itself with comparable confidence.
biography: Nahsicht studies the HyperNorm collection album with a glass kept below his own thoughtful eyes. A card allowing a memory to remain useful without being complete opens his small worried mouth: a detail is either recognised or still asking for a better angle. Hunky & Dory request the correct account. He brings the page nearer, pleased that looking again remains a thing he can choose.
note: Die Erinnerung ist scharf. Das Beweisstück wurde um Annäherung gebeten.

name: Opa Gleichnoch
props: brass pocket watch with short chain
personality: He has not cancelled the afternoon and would appreciate a small pause before it starts expecting him in full.
biography: Gleichnoch checks his watch in the HyperNorm courtyard with a yawn too substantial to pass as a remark. A card allowing rest to belong to an active day lifts his sleepy eyes: an appointment is either kept or not yet quite begun. Men in Black request punctual engagement. He steadies the short cane, intending to remain present even when presence needs a quieter minute.
note: Die Teilnahme ist zugesagt. Die Wachheit bittet um einen kurzen Aufschub.
